verdict.rationale: BVNK documents generating API credentials (a Hawk Auth ID and Secret Key used to sign each request), so an agent can be given its own API key. Nothing in the evidence shows those credentials can be scoped by permission, resource, wallet or amount, which is the heart of this story. Missing for 10: documented permission scopes or role-restricted API keys, per-key resource/wallet/spend limits, agent-specific credential issuance, and independent corroboration.
